mapper.sql: customer_markets.id AS id, customer_markets.`name` AS name, customer_markets.zone_id AS zoneId, customer_zones.`name` AS zoneName, customer_markets.created AS created, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, customer_markets.modified AS modified, CONCAT(editor.first_name, ' ', editor.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM customer_markets LEFT JOIN customer_zones ON customer_zones.id = customer_markets.zone_id LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = customer_markets.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS editor ON editor.id = customer_markets.modified_by

WHERE customer_markets.is_active = 1
AND ( customer_markets.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customer_zones.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_markets ( `name`, zone_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{market.name}, #{market.zoneId}, NOW(), #{market.createdBy}, #{market.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_markets SET `name` = #{market.name}, zone_id = #{market.zoneId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{market.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{market.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE customer_markets SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
